scope.in_scope: blind stair from-scratch training on MuJoCo (CPU only): flat approach, step1, step2, continuous 5-step, plus a standalone flat approach/stop evaluation
out_of_scope: vx_hat / rolling speed-estimation head: NOT used on the stair line; that is the rolling line's C arm
full flat driving (forward/reverse/turn/arc, braking distance, 10 s dwell): owned by the rolling policy
Isaac Lab cross-simulator acceptance and any real-robot work: not started
controller overlays (yawhold, speedgate): documented only, not implemented
scope.cpu_only: MuJoCo + SB3, SubprocVecEnv process workers, device cpu; the GPU is owned by the Isaac line and must stay untouched

description: Arm S: single-frame 60-dim observation, no history. Reference arm for the shape/parameter-count comparison.

observation.history_note: This arm has no history: the observation is exactly the 60-dim single frame used by the pinned training env.

components.name: command_error
components.source: command - (0.4, 0, 0); command is constant (0.4,0,0) on every stage

components.name: joint_pos_minus_default
components.source: qpos[qa] - default_joint_pos; wheel angles wrapped to [-2pi, 2pi]

project_convention_not_used.definition: 60 current + 12 offsets (2,4,...,24 steps) x 55 dims = 720, covering 480 ms by subsampling
project_convention_not_used.reason: This experiment uses the consecutive six-frame stack (360 dims, 100 ms). Mixing the 360 and 720 conventions is forbidden; the choice is operator decision OD-2.

history.definition: one frame, advanced once per policy step

network.log_std_init_note: from-scratch arms start at std 1.0 for exploration; the pinned fine-tune used log(0.12) because it resumed a competent actor
network.note: actor width/depth identical across the S/H0/H6 arms; only the input width changes

ppo.target_kl_note: null on purpose: the prior baseline used the SB3 default; the pinned fine-tune's target_kl=0.015 stops updates at step 0 ('Early stopping at step 0 due to reaching max kl')

stages.name: flat_approach
stages.description: Flat ground, same robot/contact configuration as the stair stages, no riser. The robot starts 0.35 m behind the nominal start and must reach x = 0.30 m (0.40 m before where the first riser would be) and hold a stable four-wheel stance for 0.5 s. Run this stage standalone before any stair budget.

stages.name: step1
stages.description: One 0.06 m step whose top surface is the 2.00 m landing (x 0.70-2.70 m).

stages.name: step2
stages.description: Two 0.06 m steps, 0.31 m treads, x 0.70-3.01 m.

stages.name: continuous
stages.description: Five 0.06 m steps, 0.31 m treads, x 0.70-3.94 m. This is the target stage, never the first thing to train.

geometry.readback: every stage builds its model and reads levels / rise / tread / x_range back from the loaded model; the values are asserted against the config derivation and the known geometry (tolerance 1e-6)
geometry.tread_note: tread is fixed at 0.31 m on every stage so the known geometry can be asserted. The pinned env sampled tread {0.31,0.35,0.39} from the scene seed; that is a deliberate, recorded difference.
geometry.rise_note: rise is fixed at 0.06 m instead of the pinned 6/8/10 cm rise curriculum.

curriculum.eligibility: full start from the bottom AND not manual AND promotion signal satisfied AND no hard protection
curriculum.demotion_rule: hard protection demotes immediately; demote_after consecutive zero-progress from-bottom episodes demote; manual top placement and mid-course resets never feed either counter

alternatives.note: all four wheels must have been credited with the top tread at least once; ignores the 0.5 s hold
longest simultaneous four-wheel top load >= X s; X in {0.15,0.20,0.26} showed the same discrimination because per-seed values are either 0 or >= 0.26 s

curriculum.warning: The task-defined signal measured 0/6 on 1-, 2- and 5-step terrain for all three arms and four-wheel top load peaks at 0.26 s < 0.50 s, so this ladder will not promote past stage 0 unless the operator changes the signal. This is deliberate: the default is not loosened here.

nonwheel_contact.note: a contact at or above this force counts as a non-wheel touch

torque.budget_source: deploy/as2w/contracts/wheel_contract_v1.json torque_budget_nm = 13.5 (90 % of the verified 15 Nm hardware limit); AGENTS.md section 3 applies 90 % to every axis
torque.deviation_from_pinned: the pinned training source clips all 16 axes at the raw MJCF ctrlrange (100 %: hip/thigh 60, calf 90, wheel 15). Every existing stair baseline, including the 5/6 initial arm, was trained at 100 %. The 90pct mode is the AGENTS.md-compliant configuration and the default here; --torque-clip mjcf_ctrlrange reproduces the baseline envelope in one command.

mujoco.label: measured
mujoco.detail: contact forces from mj_contactForce plus the exact actuator ctrl clip; per-frame peak and saturation counts are logged

isaac.label: estimated
isaac.detail: Isaac implicit-drive effort telemetry is a software clamp estimate; not used by this line

actual_drive_torque.label: not_measured
actual_drive_torque.detail: no trustworthy real-actuator torque readback exists for AS2-W

evidence_rules.improvement_rule: With 6 holdout seeds the resolution is 1/6. An arm counts as better only when it improves at least 2 seeds on the compared metric; a 1-seed difference is reported as no difference. Aggregate means must never hide single-seed noise.
evidence_rules.threshold_pairs: training termination and formal acceptance thresholds are recorded separately and never merged

baseline.source: prior from-scratch short runs in /root/gpufree-data/as2w-runs/w1w2-stair-scratch.kuZUnA (h1, h6), 16384 env steps, 4 CPU workers, rise 0.06, supported progress, seeds 28001-28006

h1.note: stands still; std ~0.99 and approx_kl 0.065-0.179 show the policy never converged at 16384 steps

h6.note: moves 0.09-0.25 m but never reaches the first riser

known_failure_modes: the old from-scratch short run barely moves forward (best seed 0.079 m, 0.590 m from the first riser, never touched the stairs)
lateral drift past |y| = 0.65 is the shared blocker for every arm and every step count
four-wheel simultaneous top load caps at 0.26 s while acceptance needs 0.50 s, so course_completed-based promotion never fires
a 4096-step fine-tune destroys first-step ability ('Early stopping at step 0 due to reaching max kl'); freezing the actor at equal budget keeps 5/6

overlay_controls.note: The diagnostic line ran controller-level single-factor overlays (action vector only; weights, reward, thresholds and geometry untouched) on one checkpoint and 6 seeds. Mechanism: with the stairs removed the same policy turns 32-163 deg and drifts 1.35-7.63 m on flat ground, so the lateral bound is a heading-loss consequence, not a geometry/contact problem. speedgate is the only overlay that moved D from 0/6 to 2/6. No overlay is implemented or enabled here; the training control law must match the formal contract. Operator decision OD-4.

flat_eval.note: Research gate for the stair policy on flat ground only: low-speed approach and the natural stop at the approach line. Full flat driving (forward/reverse/turn/arc, braking distance, 10 s dwell) belongs to the rolling policy and is explicitly not evaluated here.

operator_decisions.question: Promotion signal: keep the task-defined top_stable_hold (measured 0/6, ladder stalls at stage 0) or switch to all_wheels_top / longest_all4_top_s? Default stays top_stable_hold and the dry-run warns loudly.

Observation history: this line uses the consecutive six-frame 360-dim stack (100 ms), not the project's existing 720-dim subsampled history (480 ms). Confirm before comparing against any 720-dim policy.

Torque envelope: default 90pct (hip/thigh 54, calf 81, wheel 13.5) per AGENTS.md section 3, while every existing stair baseline was trained at 100 % MJCF ctrlrange. Confirm, or run --torque-clip mjcf_ctrlrange for a like-for-like baseline.
Candidate controller overlays (yawhold, speedgate) are documented but not implemented or enabled; confirm they stay out of the training contract.
Budget: 65536 env steps (4 CPU workers x 128 steps x 128 updates) is a trend budget, 4x the 16384 baseline. Confirm before any longer run.

pinned_training_copy.role: control / reward / termination contract; the repo copy is edited by the other stair agent so this copy is pinned instead

w1w2_stair_env.role: milestone accounting / stage builder reference (parity gated)

mujoco_screen.role: MuJoCo model loading, target limits, dynamics stress

as2w_flat_xml.role: robot + ground MJCF used for every stage

fall_recovery_contract.role: joint order / default pose / control_dt / action scales

wheel_contract.role: torque budget source; the file is owned and being edited by the rolling line, so its hash is observed at prep time and only the consumed fields are checked

agents_md.role: rules (90 % torque, separated thresholds, delivery checklist) referenced by this config

dispatch.dispatch_unit: Nm at data.ctrl; data.actuator_force is the measured solver force
dispatch.previous_action_semantics: executed (delayed, clipped to +-action_clip) action; equals the raw policy action when |a| <= action_clip and delay = 0

fields.name: target_wheel_pre_filter
fields.label: 16*action[12:] after the action clip, before any wheel limit/filter

fields.name: target_wheel_clipped
fields.label: after the URDF wheel velocity limit

fields.name: target_wheel_dispatch
fields.label: final wheel target captured at the data.ctrl assignment point

fields.name: tau_actuator_coord_nm
fields.label: data.actuator_force (joint torque only for gear=1 direct motors)

fields.name: tau_joint_qfrc_nm
fields.label: data.qfrc_actuator: simulated joint actuator torque (dof space)

fields.name: torque_clip_mode
fields.label: where the 90% budget bites (hip/thigh 54, calf 81, wheel 13.5)

fields.name: wheel_limit_rad_s
fields.label: URDF wheel speed limit used for the clip

fields.name: history_newest
fields.label: newest frame the next policy step will see

fields.name: history_sha256
fields.label: sha256 over the whole float32 window

fields.name: field_order
fields.label: observation field names in contract order

tap_log.sampling: one row per control step (stride 1) capped at max_rows; raw windows saved every window_every_steps steps, on the first 2 and last 2 steps of every episode, and for +/-3 steps around the first occurrence of each failure kind (max_windows), as .npz plus <out>/windows/index.jsonl
tap_log.divergence_note: history_sha256 localises the first differing policy step; the field name/index needs that step's raw window (see fs_stair_replay.py)

phase_gate.baseline_definition: minimal-variable baseline: deployment-consistent action wrapper (clip + explicit identity filter/rate-limit/delay), nominal mass/inertia, nominal friction, nominal gains, no push, no observation noise, one shared initial-state distribution

advance_to_disturbance_criteria.rule: the baseline does not auto-advance; the operator unlocks phase 2 after all three capabilities are demonstrated on the 6 holdout seeds

A_s1_flat_approach.definition: flat_approach stage completed: approach line reached and a stable four-wheel stance held for TOP_HOLD_S
A_s1_flat_approach.metric: flat_approach holdout episodes with complete=true and not terminated

B_s1_front_wheel_ascends.definition: at least one front wheel (FL/FR) credited with tread level >= 1 after >= 8 N sustained for >= 60 ms

C_top_rear_wheels_follow.definition: all four wheels credited with the top tread (rear wheels followed)

D_top_hold.definition: all four wheels simultaneously loaded on the top tread for >= 0.5 s (TOP_HOLD_S), the mujoco_screen.py:295 criterion

advance_to_disturbance_criteria.adjudication: 6 seeds give a 1/6 resolution; an improvement counts only when it changes at least 2 seeds

sources: deploy/as2w/runtime/deploy.yaml (rolling gyro-1: action clip 6.0, scales 0.35/16.0, torque_limits_nm hip/thigh 54, calf 81, wheel 13.5, observation filter none)
deliveries/as2w-deploy/omni-blind-stairs-r270-preview/rl_deploy.yaml (stair preview: command_filter alpha 0.12 on the COMMAND, 720-dim history)
deployment_consistency.action_filter: none in the deployed wrapper; the stair preview's alpha=0.12 filter is on the COMMAND and the stair command is constant (0.4,0,0)
deployment_consistency.action_delay: 0 frames by default; the eval-only switch exists for link-loss tests
deployment_consistency.history: the deployed rolling wrapper has no history; the stair preview uses 720-dim subsampled history, which is a DIFFERENT contract from this 360-dim consecutive six-frame stack (OD-2)
deployment_consistency.phase1_status: filter/rate-limit/delay are the identity at alpha=1.0/None/0, so the wrapper reproduces the pinned training env; every parameter is explicit and fingerprinted so a future deployment filter is a versioned change

control_contract.change_rule: Any change to the filter position/alpha, rate limit, action delay, history field semantics/order, action clip/scales, torque dispatch or the initial-state distribution changes contract_fingerprint. If the stored fingerprint no longer matches, the runner prints CONTROL_CONTRACT_CHANGED, refuses --run, and asks for a bumped control_contract_version plus replay and baseline regression. --accept-contract-change is accepted only with --dry-run/--replay.
control_contract.per_arm_note: the fingerprint is per arm because the history definition is part of the contract; the three arms share control/initial-state/dispatch
